title: Kvarðinn game phase state diagram
description: The phase of one room's Game. newGame() starts in lobby, and only act() changes it, for the player whose action it applies; a refused action changes nothing. The room's Durable Object stores the Game, so the phase survives restarts. Lobby-only edits (team, settings, shuffle, move-player, custom cards) and rename and kick in any phase leave the phase as it is, except kicking the clue-giver mid-round.

states.description: Players join and pick teams; the host changes the settings and adds custom scales. No round.
A round has a card, a hidden target and a clue-giver; only the giver's view carries the target. The giver may redraw the card.
The clue is out; the guessing team (everyone in co-op), not the giver, drags the shared pointer, and the locker locks it.
Team mode with the bonus on: the other team picks left or right of the pointer, and its bonus locker confirms.
The round is scored (4, 3, 2 or 0, plus the bonus point); every view now carries the target.
A team reached the goal with a lead, or the co-op rounds ran out; only the host's again leaves it.

transitions.guard: Two players on each team (two in all in co-op), and some custom scales if only those are to be played
transitions.action: startGame(): reset scores, turns and the deck, pick the starting team at random, then startRound(): pick the giver, the locker and the bonus locker, draw a card, place the target at 5–95.

transitions.trigger: act(move) by a member of the guessing team other than the giver
transitions.action: Set the pointer, clamped to 0–100; only the pointer is sent after the mover's first move.

transitions.trigger: act(lock) by the locker, or by any guesser while the locker is offline
transitions.guard: The bonus setting is on, it is team mode, and someone on the other team is online

transitions.trigger: act(lock) by the locker, or by any guesser while the locker is offline
transitions.action: reveal(): score the pointer against the target; decide whether the game is finished.

transitions.trigger: act(pick) by a member of the other team
transitions.action: Store the side, L or R.

transitions.trigger: act(bonus-lock) by the bonus locker, or by any member of the other team while it is offline
transitions.action: reveal(): score the round, and one point to the other team if the target is on the side it picked.
startRound() for the other team (the group in co-op) and its next online clue-giver.

transitions.trigger: act(skip), or act(kick) of the clue-giver, by the host
transitions.action: undoRound() then startRound(): the round does not count, and the same team plays again with its next clue-giver.

act(skip), or act(kick) of the clue-giver, by the host
